datasets.title: Austria Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 4.3 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 82% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 1 year, 10 months ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 2% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap as volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) into standardized geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage). The dataset represents the current state of OSM building coverage in Austria with quality metrics indicating 82% completeness relative to AI-mapped estimates.
